items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: So Oscar Randall, he took it then.

ctx.x: Randall. He was a pretty good violin player. And so he took up several of his bands and Albert's players for a while because the band began to draw a little bit and waking up, he couldn't get out to sheet. And so he had to let somebody else play. So Oscar Randall, he took it then. And we played sheet music. Wasn't much on the ragtime. Did you ever play anything by ear at all?
Did you ever play anything by ear at all? Without reading from the music? Did you ever play anything by ear at all? Without reading from the music?
